title: Serea — Unified AI Document Workspace & Local LLM Suite
summary: Serea is a cross-platform mobile and laptop application built with Flutter combining iLovePDF, ChatGPT, and NotebookLM with an offline on-device LLM brain (Qwen 3.5, Llama 3.2, nomic-embed-text) for private multi-doc RAG, Question Paper Generator, and PDF toolsets.
text:
Serea is an all-in-one AI document workspace built with Flutter for Mobile (Android/iOS) and Laptop (Windows/macOS/Linux). It brings together the document tools of iLovePDF, the chat depth of ChatGPT, and the synthesis of NotebookLM:
• On-Device LLM Brain: Runs local models (Qwen 3.5 4B, Llama 3.2 1B, nomic-embed-text) completely offline with 100% privacy.
• Multi-Doc Vector Chat & Semantic Search: Ask questions and search across personal documents with exact page citations.
• Question Paper Generator: Upload syllabus or textbook chapters to generate balanced exam papers with marks distribution and PDF/Word export.
• Study Book Generator: Compiles lecture slides and notes into formatted, printable A4 offline study guides.
• Study Guides & MCQ Quizzes: Auto-generates flashcards, practice quizzes, and summary cheat sheets.
• PDF Suite: Visual drag-and-drop page organizer, neural scanned OCR extractor, and 9+ format converter.

title: Echo — AI Communication Copilot (Chrome Extension)
summary: Echo is a privacy-first Chrome Extension (MV3) that sits inside messaging apps (WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Discord, X) and suggests 3 instant replies sounding authentically like you using NVIDIA NIM and an offline 'Own Mind' NLP engine.
text:
Echo is an AI communication copilot Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) that sits directly inside web messaging platforms (WhatsApp Web, Instagram DM, Telegram, Discord, X):
• 1-Click Smart Replies: Generates 3 contextual response drafts in <180ms right above your active chat box.
• Authentic Persona Engine: Learns your personal writing tone, favorite slang, emojis, greetings, and sentence structures.
• Ghost Mode Tone Switcher: Switch instantly between Executive Formal, Casual Friendly, Short & Punchy, and Empathetic tones.
• Hybrid Brain: Combines cloud NVIDIA NIM (Llama 3.3) with an offline 'Own Mind' NLP engine during internet outages with 100% local storage privacy.

title: AweFill — Zero-LLM Smart Form Autofill Extension
summary: AweFill is a 100% offline, air-gapped Chrome Extension (React 19, TypeScript) that autofills repetitive job applications and college admission forms in 1 click with zero LLM costs using a deterministic matching engine (28/28 verified tests).
text:
AweFill is a privacy-first, zero-LLM Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) built with React 19, TypeScript 5.7, and Vite 6:
• Deterministic Matching Engine: Leverages 200+ field alias taxonomy and fuzzy string algorithms (Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, Sørensen-Dice) to detect form inputs in <15ms with zero token cost.
• Isolated Shadow DOM Drawer: Shows an in-page sliding review panel (#awefill-overlay-root) with zero CSS conflicts so users can review data before applying.
• Local Correction Memory: Learns custom manual overrides on unstandardized domains with 98%+ accuracy on subsequent visits.
• Security Guarantee: Hardcoded blacklisting of passwords/CVVs/OTPs, strict zero auto-submit policy, and 28/28 verified unit tests.
